## What changes

A short description of the change.

## Why

The problem this solves, or the decision it records.

## Authority

Which document is now the authority for the new behavior? If this change introduces syntax, semantics, or a standard library name, link the specification update.

## Checklist

- [ ] The specification was updated before or with the implementation.
- [ ] Examples still comply with the specification.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.
- [ ] Commits are one logical change each, and messages state the decision.
